tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mol gtam/ bsngo ba rgyas bsdus gang 'os kyi smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo bud+dha ya/ skabs 'dir skabs don brda sprod par byed pa'i lo rgyus tshig 'ga' gleng bar zhu 'tshal/ zhu ba'i skabs na bla med thar gling bgrod pa'i ded dpon/ rnam grol dga' ston stsol pa'i 'dren mchog srid pa'i zug rngu 'byin pa'i rtsal ldan/ rtsa brgyud yongs kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas/ lung rtogs ngo bo skyob pa dam chos/ rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun/ de ltar dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum/ spyir zhing khams rab 'byams rnams na bzhugs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyad par du'ang thub bstan rin chen tshogs kyis gzhi bzung*/ bstan pa'i chu bo mang po 'du mkhas/ phrin las rlung brgya phyogs bcur 'gyed mdzad/ rang re'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid na'ang*/ byin rlabs chu rgyun spel ba'i gangs ri/ nyes pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i dag byed/ rnam mang dge legs ster ba'i sa gzhi/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi rten/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar bzhugs shing*/ lha rdzas rin chen tshogs las legs grub/ stong nyid ye shes rdo rjes byin rlabs/ rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dges mdzad/ bkod mtshan mchod pa'i sprin spungs rnams dang*/ thub bstan gangs ri bsrung ba'i seng chen/ phas rgol glang po 'joms pa'i stobs ldan/ bstan 'dzin ri dwags bsrung ba'i dpa' bo/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs pa lags/ dkon mchog de dag dang ngo bo gcig cing mdzad pa 'phrin las gnyis su ma mchis pa/ thub bstan dam chos kun gyi bdag po/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun yongs kyi gtsug rgyan/ ston pa bu ram shing pa'i rgyal tshab/ bla ma rin po che de nyid 'dus pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par bzhugs pa lags/

rje nyid kyi thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor nyer 'tsho'i sprin gyis ma sgribs shing*/ mkhyen pa'i snang byed phyogs brgyar spros pa las/ phan bde 'dab brgya'i tshal du nye bar bsdus pa/ dad can dwang ba 'dren pa'i dmigs rkyen/ 'byor ldan bsod nams bsogs pa'i zhing mchog bslab gsum 'od zer 'phro ba'i snang byed/ dge 'dun dbu sde gnyis kyi gral gyi gzhi bzung*/ sde snod gzhung brgya shes pa'i mkhas pa/ sdom gsum rgyud la ldan pa'i btsun pa/ byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i bzang po/ yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam pa mang pos gral gyi gzhi thog drangs/ sngon bsags bsod nams 'khrungs pa'i lhun po/ mnga' 'bangs chu gter rgyas pa'i rgya mtsho/ mtho dman kun la snyoms pa'i nyin byed/ mi che bar gyur pa rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ sgra dang tshad ma'i dpa' ngar dang ldan pa/ bzo dang gso ba'i byams brtse dang bcas/ phyi nang gsang gsum rig pa'i mchod 'os/ yon tan mkhas pa sbyang ba rnams kyis gral gyi zur brgyan/ mchod 'os thod bzhin bkur ba'i dad can/ mchod rdzas lhun po 'degs pa'i stobs ldan/ gtong phod lugs brgyas spras pa'i mdzangs pa/ bsod nams can sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams dang*/ gzhan phan lag pa skyong ba'i mdzangs pa/ rang don g.yang sa bsrung ba'i khrel ldan/ bde 'khyug glog ltar spro ba'i yid 'ongs/ bya ba mdzad pa phyag bde ba dang bcas pas gral gyi mtha' bsten nas/ 'di ltar chos dang srid pa'i phun tshogs bzang pos/ phyogs rnams kun nas ngang gis rab 'dus/ dge shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs rab gsal mdzad/ 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa mtha' dag bslu ba med pa'i rten 'brel bzang pos gdan mngon par 'dzom/ dkar ba las kyi gzhi bzung*/ dag pa smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ chos dang dam tshig zab mo'i sgo nas 'brel pa zab/ phan bde'i lo tog smin pa'i 'dun sa bzang por rnam grol dge ba'i char chen 'bebs pa'i thabs mchog khyad par can la phod pas na tshogs pa shin tu bzang*/

bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis par gda' na/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus dang*/ rgyan dam pa chos 'byung gi lo rgyus gnyis/ dang po la steng du rje'i gdung rabs/ 'og tu 'bangs kyi mi rabs/ stong sde sa'i chags tshul/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag sogs gleng sgo mang bar mchis mod/ mdo tsam gyi dbang du bgyi bar gda' na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir/ rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba sogs bskal pa dang po'i rgyal po lnga/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi stan phyed la dbang sgyur ba nga las nu la sogs pa 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po lnga/ de nas shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po brgyad khri dang bdun stong*/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gtum po rab snang*/ bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed/ ser skya'i rgyal po don thams cad grub pa'i bar spel legs su byon pa lags/ de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i gdung 'dzin rje gnya' khri btsan po zhes bya ba de nyid bod kyi rgyal po la snga ba lags/ de nas gnam gyi khri bdun/ sa'i legs drug log gyi lde brgyad la sogs pa rim par brgyud cing*/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa tho tho ri snyan zhal gyi dus su/ dam pa chos kyi dbu rnyed/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su srol gtod/ khri song lde btsan gyi dus su dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ mnga' bdag ral pa can gyi dus su rab tu byung ba rnams kyi zhabs spyi bor blangs/ gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ rab tu byung ba re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od khu dbon gyi sku ring la gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i glegs bam spyan drangs jo bo rje lha gcig bod du spyan 'dren pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa sogs chos rgyal gyi skyes bu chen po rnams gser gyi phreng ba ltar rim par byon pa lags/

gnyis pa 'bangs kyi mi rabs chags tshul gyi dbang du bgyis na/ bskal pa bzang po'i mi rnams lha yul nas 'phos te skyes pas rigs so so'i dbye ba ma mchis/ phyis rtsod ldan gyi dus su mi rigs bzhir gyes/ deng sang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na rigs bzhi'i sde tshan so sor nges/ rgya nag pa'i yul na rigs 'chol bar gnas/ bod chung ngu na rigs kyi sde tshan so sor mi 'byed/ bod chen po na mi'u gdong drug gi rigs su nges pa las/ de ring skabs su yon gyi bdag po'i rigs rus cho 'brangs phun sum tshogs pa 'di zhes bya ba dang*/ mdzad pa phrin las 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba la sogs pa rang rang gi che ge'i yig tshang rnams brjod/ gsum pa stong sde sa'i chags tshul la/ phyi mngon pa'i lugs dang*/ nang gsang sngags kyi lugs sogs gleng sgo mang bar mchis na'ang*/ skabs 'dir gling khyad par du 'phags pa 'dzam bu'i gling na/ yul chen sum cu so drug yul phran sum brgya dang drug cu yod par bshad pa las/ gtso che bar gyur pa/ shar na longs spyod kyi 'byung khungs rgya nag lho na dam pa chos kyi 'byung khungs 'phags yul/ nub na rig pa'i 'byung gnas kha che/ byang na dpa' bo'i 'byung gnas hor yul/ de dag gi dbus na bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi gnas mchog kha ba can gyi ljongs te/ ya rabs 'du ba'i yul chen ni de tsam du nges lags/ bzhi pa 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag la/ sngon rdzogs ldan gyi dus su rgyal po'i khrims dang*/ rgan rabs kyi lugs srol la ma ltos par thams cad dge ba bcu la ngang gis longs spyod do// gsum ldan gyi mgo tshugs nas dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas/ 'jig rten gyi lugs bzang ngan dang*/ rigs mtho dman dang*/ ya rabs ma rabs kyi rnam gzhag ngo tsha dang khrel yod sogs/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag rnams dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa lags/ mdor na mi chos kyi lo rgyus de thams cad kyang deng sang skabs su yab du dge zhing yum du btsun pa/

ngo tsha shes pa'i lus la khrel yod kyi gos gyon zhing*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mchod pa'i gnas su bskur ba'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la tshang ba de lags/ gnyis pa rgyan dam pa chos 'byung gi lo rgyus la'ang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshul/ bya las can bka' drin che ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa dang por byang chub du thugs bskyed pa'i tshul/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs pa dang snying rje pad dkar gyi mdo'i rjes su 'brangs pa dang*/ bskal pa bzang po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs pa sogs mang zhing gleng bar gda' na'ang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo'i nges don mthar thug gi dbang du bgyis na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje can 'di brjod du med pa'i bskal pa mang po'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas nas/ rtsod pa'i dus 'dir mchog gi sprul pa'i skus gling bzhi ther 'bum du ngo mtshar can gyi mdzad pa bye ba phrag brgya cig car du ston pa'i tshul gyis byon pa lags/ bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshul la/ ston pa chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par gzhag pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi spyan ldan nyan thos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis theg pa che chung gi bka'i bsdu ba rim par mdzad/ rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mkhan po rnams kyi drang don dang nges don gyi rim pa legs par phye/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad nas/ rgya gar 'phags yul du bstan pa rin po che nam langs shing nyi ma shar bar gyur pa lags/ bod yul du sprul pa'i sku mthon mi sam bho ṭas bod kyi yi ge brtsams/ dam pa chos kyi srol gtod/ chos kyi spyan ldan ka cog zhang gsum gyis sde snod gsum dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa bsgyur/ 'jam pa'i rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes mchog rin chen bzang pos/

rgyud sde bzhi'i tshad ldan gyi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa bsgyur/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i lo chen blo ldan bzang pos/ gsung rab mang po'i zhu chen dang bshad rgyud kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bshes gnyen dam pa tho rog 'ban gsum dang*/ bya skyi sha gsum la sogs pa rnams kyis ka cog zhang gsum nas brgyud pa'i 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung bas bka' drin che/ yang sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'byung gnas bod yul du byon nas dam pa'i chos la phrag dog gi gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ gsang sngags bla med kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad nas skal bzang mang po rig 'dzin gyi sa la bkod/ dam pa rgya gar bod du byon nas lta ba rnam par dag pa dbu ma'i lam dang*/ rten 'brel sna tshogs kyi sgo nas/ 'gro ba mang po phan bde'i sa la bkod/ sangs rgyas zhi ba 'tsho bod yul du byon nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba rab byung gi srol gtod/ bstan pa'i snying po dbu ma'i gzhung btsugs/ kha che paṇa chen bod yul du byon nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la slob pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ rje mar pa rgya gar du byon nas grub chen na ro dang mai tri'i gdams pa spyan drangs/ sgrub rgyud chu bo'i rgyun lta bu 'dzugs pa mdzad/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mkha' 'gro ma'i zab chos spyan drangs nas bstan pa'i snying po dar bar mdzad/ rje 'brog mi dang bla chen sa skya pa yab sras kyis mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i rgyun nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad cing*/ 'jig rten lugs kyi gzhung lugs bzang pos 'gro ba mang po phan bde'i sa la 'khod par mdzad/ gsum pa bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus la/ spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams 'gro ba yongs la bka' drin che/ khyad par mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid mi mjed 'jig rten khams pa rnams la bka' drin che/

'dzam bu gling pa rnams la khyad par du'ang*/ mtha' bral dbu mi 'don gzigs klu sgrub yab sras/ chos mngon rgya mtsho'i mthar son thogs med sku mched/ rnam dag rigs pa'i srol 'byed phyogs glang yab sras sogs shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po rnams dang*/ dpal ldan in+d+ra bhu ti/ grub pa mchog brnyes pa sar ha/ stobs kyi mgon po bi ru pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs pa rnams la/ dang por sprul pa'i chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ bar du bla chen po'i mkhan brgyud/ de rjes gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen a ti sha chos kyi brgyud pa dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ dus phyis gangs can gyi 'gro ba phal mo che la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sprul/ chos rje sa skya pa'i chos brgyud gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ rje 'brog mi lo ts+tsha bas 'phags yul nas/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum bshad srol rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag dang bcas pa sogs spyan drangs/ dpal sa skya pa chen po nas nye bar brgyud de/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i snying po brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa rnams dang*/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī sogs nas bshad brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang bcas pa chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la nye bar brgyud pa deng sang gi bar du bshad brgyud dri ma med pa dang*/ gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che zhes sogs gang la gang 'tshams skabs dang sbyor/ rang re'i chos brgyud rnam par dag pa 'di la/ stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i dbang po nas bzung*/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nas brgyud/ rang re'i bla ma thang chung ba shākya seng ge zhes pa de dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhung lugs mang po la slabs sbyangs mthar phyin/

gsang sngags bla med kyi sgrub pa nyams su bzhes/ grub pa chen po'i go 'phang brnyes/ snang ba mtha' dag sgyu ma'i ngo bor gzigs pas bla gos kyi chun pos ri bo chen po la bug pa thal byung du phug de'i lam du chu'i rgyun bde bar drangs sngon med pa'i sar lo thog 'khrungs pa'i zhing sa bskrun/ sngags kyi nus pas rgod g.yag gi khyug bkug rmos rmo ba dang khal 'gel ba sogs kyis bran du 'khol bar mdzad/ de la sogs te rnam thar las 'byung ba'i grub pa chen po'i snyan grangs la brten nas/ 'phags pa rin po che se chen gan gyi ti shri'i go 'phang brnyes/ rjes su khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa zhus/ ti shrī dbang phyug gi lung dang las ka phul ba de nas bzung ste/ chos rje 'dus pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par zhal bzhugs pa 'di nyid kyi bar gser ri'i phreng ba ltar spel legs su byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ sgos rang rang so so la lus ngag yid gsum skyon med bskrun par byed pa'i pha dang ma/ rnam dag khrims la 'god par byed pa'i mkhan po dang slob dpon/ dbang bzhis smin nas rgyud man ngag ston pa'i dam tshig gi rdo rje 'dzin pa/ blang dor tshul bzhin 'doms mkhas dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rgya chen gzhung lugs tshul bzhin 'chad mkhas/ yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams dang*/ thar pa'i grong khyer chen por mnyam du chas pa'i chos kyi spun dang*/ rdo rje'i mched po dam pa rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par de ring gi skabs su gzhan sde stobs kyis 'joms pa'i dpa' bo/ rang sde byams pas skyong ba'i mdzangs pa/ mkhas btsun rgyan gyis spras pa'i bla ma rin po che pa nyid seng ge'i khri la zhal mngon par mtho ba'i skyabs kyi 'og nas/ longs spyod ngang gis 'bab pa'i mtsho chen/ legs bshad bung ba 'du ba'i skyed tshal/ bsod nams rin po che bsog pa'i bang mdzod/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs chen rnams la/

mchod pa'i longs spyod mtsho ltar 'khyil/ 'bul ba'i dngos po ri ltar spungs/ sgrin 'grus kyi lag len/ glog ltar 'khyug chos spyod kyi rim pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par bzhugs pa'i dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bla ma gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa/ gong ma yon mchod sku khams bzang zhing phrin las ngang gis 'phel ba/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams dam pa'i chos smra ba'i so ga dang*/ skyes bu rnyed pa dang bkur stis brgyan par bya ba'i phyir ram/ de las khyad par du zhes sogs skabs dang sbyar nas/ de ltar sgrub pa yin zhes zhu bar gda' bas rjes su yi rang*/ de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen por bsngo ba/ yon yongs su sbyong byed zhal nas gsungs pa'i mdo/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i smon lam/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong la gtor ma'i rim pa/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ bsod nams bsogs pa'i bgyi ba la yang dang yang du tshogs pa'i smon lam yang gnang bar zhu// //yang gsang sngags kyi sgrub mchod pa tshogs longs kyi dbus su mol gtam bsdus pa byed na 'di ltar/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs shing*/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i skyabs 'og nas/ rang re dpon slob rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du stan mngon par 'dzom sku gsung thugs lha sku'i rnam rol tu gzigs pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun sde gnyis pos gral gyi gzhi gzung*/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bdag pos gral gyi gung mnan/ gang shar lha sku'i rnam rol du gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyis gral gyi thog ma mdzad/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las ma g.yos bzhin du rgyud sde'i don phyin ci ma log par 'chad shes pa'i yon tan mkhas pa rnams kyis zur nas brgyan/

gsang sngags kyi kun spyod las ma g.yos bzhin du/ phrin las sna tshogs sgrub par byed pa'i las kyi rdo rje rnams kyis mtha' brten te/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa'i rdo rje spun thams cad kyang dbang dang dam tshig gi 'brel pa zab/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pas ma gos pa'i tshogs pa bzang*/ lo rgyus na/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid rigs brgya'i rnam rol gyis dngos po kun la khyab byed du bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ de ring gi skabs su tshangs par spyod pa'i rtul shugs la nye bar gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rjes su mthun pa'i dpa' bo ston mo bzang zhing gya nom pas nye bar mchod pa 'di nyid/ spyir ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par du tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du gsang sngags kyi kun spyod bzang po dang mi bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ yon gyi bdag po rdo rje slob ma ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bsgrub par gda'/ de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad/ rigs ma lus pa kun gyi bdag po khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phangs su slob par bgyi ba'i mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes brjod do// 'dir smras pa/ ya rabs tshogs pa'i gral dag tu// mol gtam rgyas par smra mkhas na// mang po'i dbus su mngon par mtho// rgyal pos bsngags pa'ang 'thob par 'gyur// de skad shākya seng ge ba'i// mtshan dkar grub pa brnyes gang gi /gdung 'dzin kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis// bskul nas legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// // ༄// na mo bud+dha ya/ de nas rang dang gzhan gyis mngon par 'dus byas pa'i dge ba yul khyad par can du sgyur bar bya ba la tshul gnyis te/ theg pa thun mong gi lugs dang*/

thun mong min pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi bsngo ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rnam gzhag go bar bya ba dang*/ bsngo ba ji ltar bya ba nyid ngag tu brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ gang bsngo na/ mngon par 'dus byas pa'i dge ba rnams so// gang du bsngo na/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu byang chub kyi sems rin po che gnyis kyi don du bsngo/ yid la byed pa gang gis bsngo na/ 'khor gsum du mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pas ma gos shing*/ gsum po la snang cha ma dor ba'i thabs kyis bsngo/ bsngos pa las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te// 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas// zhes pa ltar/ bsngo ba po rang 'phen pa'i shugs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dpang por gsol ba'i bden mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings la bya byed rung ba'i stobs las yin no// bsngo rgyu rang gi ngo bo ni/ dug gsum med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas kun nas slang ba'i sems byung sems pa'o// bsngo ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ bsngo rgyu'i rdzas de 'bras bu khyad par can gyi sa bon du 'debs pa'o// gang du 'debs na/ zhing khyad par can kun gzhi'i steng du 'debs/ gang gis na/ bsngo bas so// ji ltar 'debs na/ 'bras bu 'byung rung gi nus pa mthu can du byas pa'i sgo nas so// 'bras bu yang mthar thug dang gnas skabs kyi dbye bas gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bral ba'i 'bras bu ste/ byang chub gsum po gang rung du bsngos pa'o// der bsngos pa'i dge ba ni bar ma dor chud 'dza' ba mi srid pas na dge ba mi zad pa zhes bya'o// gnas skabs la rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu bsod nams chen po can dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu mngon par mtho ba'i bde ba dang*/ bdag po'i 'bras bu yul khams bzang po la longs spyod pa sogs so// gsum po 'di ni zag bcas kyi dge ba la sad byed kyi rkyen dang ma phrad na ma bsngos kyang zhar las byung bas na bsngo ba yang dag pa ni min te/

'khor ba'i rgyu nyid du bsngos pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyi phyir na bsngos pas mi 'dzad pa yang min te/ des na gdul bya rang rang gi rigs dang 'tshams par byang chub gsum po gang rung du bsngo ba zhes bya ba'i don gyi gtso bo yin no// de ltar bsngos pa'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam nas 'byung ba lta bu'o// de ltar na rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dun pa ni bsngo ba dang*/ de nas sems can gyi don byed par 'dun pa ni smon lam mo// gnyis pa ngag tu brjod pa'i rim pa ni/ 'di ltar dge 'dun rnams kyis bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur brjod dgos mdzad par zhu zhes brjod dgos pa yin te/ dge 'dun tshogs longs kyi bsngo ba ni mi 'grub mi srid pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dgongs su gsol/ zhes brjod dgos pa'ang yin te/ de dag gi drung du de ltar khas blangs pas dam bca' brtan pa dang*/ khas blangs mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sdom pa bzhin no// bsod nams kyi tshogs mngon par 'du byed pa po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ 'di ltar bsgrub pa la brten nas/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phangs mngon du byed nus par gyur cig gnas skabs thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ces brjod dgos pa yin te/ rkang pa dang pos smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ dge rtsa byed pa po'i khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po nus pa mthu can du brtas nas chos kyi skur gnas 'gyur rung dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs de nyid gzhan don gyi sku gnyis po 'grub rung gi rgyur bsngos pa'i phyir dang*/ rkang pa gnyis pos dge ba byed pa pos 'jug pa byang chub kyi phyogs su sems bskyed pa'i phyir/

de ltar bsngo ba dang po la byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam zhes bya zhing*/ gnyis pa la bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam zhes bya'o// de gnyis ka yang bsngo ba po ni bsod nams byed pa po rang nyid kyis bya dgos pa yin te/ rang la de'i 'dun pa ma shar na gzhan gyis bsngos kyang rang nyid kyi smon 'jug dus sems bskyed par mi 'gyur bas so// mthun 'gyur ni dge 'dun mang pos mdzad dgos te/ de dag gi bden pa'i stobs kyis smon lam de 'grub sla ba'i phyir/ rang gis de ltar bsngo mi shes na dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa sogs kyi/ sbyin pa po khyed rang 'dun pa 'di ltar mdzod la bsngos shig ces bslab pa bzhin 'dun par byas pas kyang chog pa yin te/ da ltar bsngo ba'i lag len ji ltar byed pa bzhin no// smon 'jug gi bsngo ba 'di dag lan gsum du brjod dgos pa yin te/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa khyad par can du 'gyur bas so// bsngo ba'i gtso bo ni de tsam gyis chog la/ smon lam gyi khyad par mang po dag 'debs na/ bzang po spyod pa dang*/ byams pa'i smon lam dang*/ spyod 'jug gi bsngo ba'i le'u las 'byung ba ltar rgyas par bya zhing*/ mdor bsdu dgos na/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig po de brjod pas chog pa yin te/ de'i nang du byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam grangs med pa dag 'du bar bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar spyir btang nas so sor bya ba la gnyis te/ gson po'i don du bya ba dang*/ gshin po'i don du bya ba'o// dang po la tshe ring ba'i don du bya ba dang*/ bsod nams rgyas pa'i don du bya'o// dang po la gnyis te/ tshe'i rgyu bsgrub pa dang*/ rgyu des 'bras bu 'grub par smon lam 'debs pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'gal rkyen sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sogs pa'o// dang po ni/ gzhan gyi srog gcod pa dang*/

'tsho ba'i rkyen du gyur pa mtha' dag 'phrog pa las rang nyid bzlog pa dang*/ gzhan bzlog tu 'jug pa dang*/ bzlog pa la rjes su yi rang ba sogs so// gnyis po ni/ dkon mchog gsum rnyed pa dang bkur stis mchod pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ gzhan dag 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis tshe ring du 'jug pa dang*/ rang nyid tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang len pa dang*/ gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi don bsgoms pa dang*/ de'i chos la mos pa lhur byed pa sogs so// dus min pa'i 'chi ba ni/ de dag gis bzlog par byed la/ dus kyi 'chi ba ni 'phen byed kyi las zad pa yin la/ de ni stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam gyis bzlog nus pa yin te/ las nyon gyi 'chi ba spangs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa thob nas tshe bskal par byin gyis rlob nus pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' thob nas tshe 'dor len la dbang thob ces bshad pa dang*/ nang la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa dag ni rlung srog rtsol gyi man ngag dag la brten nas dus kyi 'chi ba bzlog nus par bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po sogs mi chen gyi don du na/ mkhyen par gsol ba dang*/ smon 'jug gi bsngo ba de nyid gzhir bzhag nas steng du/ yon gyi bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ sku tshe bsring ba'i slad du/ 'di ltar bla ma dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur/ phongs pa dang mgon med pa rnams la sbyin gtong*/ gzungs sngags dang stong nyid zab mo'i sgom bzlas/ dus min par 'chi ba dag gi srog bslu/ 'jigs pas nyen pa dag gi mgon skyabs/ nang gi rnal 'byor zab mo'i sgrub pa/ 'tsho byed kyi drang srong tshul bzhin du bsten pa/ tshe'i rig byed las 'byung ba'i gso spyad kyi cho ga yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du nye bar brten pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/

bla ma'am rgyal po 'di zhes bya ba'i sku la snyun mi mnga' zhing*/ sku tshe ring bar gyur cig rkyang pa dang ldan pa dang 'dus pa'i nad chos nyid kyi ngang du zhi bar gyur cig sku'i lhun po rab tu brtan par gyur cig gsung gi nyi zer phyogs bcur 'phro bar gyur cig thugs kyi rgya mtsho rab tu gang bar gyur cig phrin las kyi nyi ma nam yang nub par ma gyur cig thugs rje'i bsil zer kun la snyoms par gyur cig dus ma yin pa'i pho nya dang mthar byed kyi zhags pa ring du bzlog par gyur cig gnod byed kyi sbyor ba thams cad stong nyid kyi rdo rjes 'joms par gyur cig 'chi med kyi dngos grub char bzhin du 'bab par gyur cig ye shes kyi bdud rtsis srog gi dbang po rgyas par gyur cig yi dam gyi lha rnams bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'chi bdag gi bdud bzlog par gyur cig rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gyis nyon mongs pa rang sa nyid du grol bar gyur cig thos bsam sgom gsum gyi gru bo ches skye rga na 'chi'i rgya mtsho bzhi mthar phyin par gyur cig tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gyi grub pa mchog gis skye 'gro mtha' dag kun dga' bar byed nus par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod do// lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// zhes sh+lau ka gcig brjod do// gnyis pa la bsod nams rgyas pa'i rgyu sgrub pa dang*/ de'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur smon pa'o// dang po ni/ chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa ste sbyin pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba bcu sgrub cing dman pa'i bsam pa las bzlog pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba bcu sgrub pa la brtson 'grus dang*/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la mi lhod pa'i brtson 'grus so// bdag med pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa'i de dag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams so// gnyis pa ni/

dpang por gsol ba dang smon 'jug tu sems bskyed pa de gnyis gzhir bzhag nas/ bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mchod pa dang bkur stis mnyes par byas pa dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs rnams zang zing gi sbyin pas mgu bar byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsar du bskrun pa dang*/ bka' dang bstan bcos dri ma med pa'i legs par bshad pas/ blo gsal gyi skye bo mgu byed kyi mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar ba dang*/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba'i sems kyis dam pa'i chos bshad pa dang*/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems kyis tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa dang*/ dge 'dun bye ba chos kyi phyogs su mthun par byas pa dang*/ bdag dang gzhan gyi dge sdig ma lus pa gtong len du byas pa'i bsam pa sbyang ba la sogs pa'i bsod nams 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa po bdag gam gzhan/ bla ma'am/ rgyal po'am khyim bdag la sogs pa ming 'di zhes bya ba/ chos mthun gyi dpal dang 'byor pa rab tu rgyas shing 'phel bar gyur cig zad mi shes pa'i bsod nams kyi gter chen po la rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis sems can re 'dod tshul bzhin du bkong nus par gyur cig chos dge ba bcu la dus rtag tu rang gi ngang gis gzhol nus par gyur cig chos dge ba bcu'i khrims kyis rang gi mnga' ris dang gdul bya skyong ba la 'gal rkyen gyi gegs cung zad kyang mi 'byung bar gyur cig bden pa smra ba'i bka' lung btsan po la log par smra ba gang gis kyang 'gong mi nus par gyur cig 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal yongs su bzung ba'i sgo nas dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang gyen du 'degs nus par gyur cig phongs pa rnams kyi re 'dod bskong nus= mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen byed nus par=

dbu rmog btsan zhing chab srid 'jam dar rgyas par= 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis longs spyod dang ldan par= 'bangs dang gdul bya thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod nas/ bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig brjod/ yang rab tu byung ba dag dam pa'i chos 'phel ba dang*/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa sogs kyi don du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags par byed pa de'i tshe ni/ spyir btang ba de gzhir gzhag pa'i steng du/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ gnas brtan nam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di zhes bgyi bas tshogs gsog bgyi ba 'di dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung*/ tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs/ thos bsam dang sgrub pa'i 'khor lo yongs su bzung ba'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ tshe rabs 'di dang gnas thams cad du bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la nan tan du bgyi ba la nam yang lhod par ma gyur cig lus dang ngag dang yid sdom pa la gnas par= 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi dga' ba dang ldan par= nyon mongs pa'i shugs drag pos nam yang mi rdzi bar gyur cig tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par= rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs= rang gi sems nyes par spyod pa mtha' dag las sdom nus par= byang chub sems dpa' dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i sdom pa gong ma dag yang dag par blangs nas rim gyis slob nus par= tshul khrims de la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mtha' dag dang bral= 'gro ba gzhan yang mang po dag tshul khrims de la 'god nus par= ces lan gsum brjod nas/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// zhes sogs brjod pa dang*/

yang legs par spyod pa de nyid la brten nas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos ma lus pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dzin nus par= skye ba thams cad du dam pa'i chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag dang thog ma nyid du zhal mjal= de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag par mnyes par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas= bdud dang sdig pa'i grogs po rnams kyi dbang du nam yang mi 'gro bar gyur cig zab pa dang rgya che ba'i theg pa chen po'i chos spyod pa la spro zhing*/ tshul bzhin du len pa dang bsgrubs pa la bar chad mi 'byung= thos bsam gyi 'khor los bstan pa'i sgron me yun ring du 'bar ba'i mthu dang ldan= sgrub pa'i 'khor los sangs rgyas kyi brgyud rgyun mi chad pa 'dzin nus= de ltar 'khor lo gnyis kyi sbyin pa po rnams kyi yon yongs su sbyongs nus= rab tu byung ba gzhan gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti la 'phrog pa med cing*/ legs par spyad pa mtha' dag la rjes su yi rangs= ces lan gsum brjod nas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// zhes sh+lau ka gcig brjod pa dang*/ yang dmigs bsal med par byas pa'i dge ba la ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ 'dir bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun btsun pa thams cad rang gzhan thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ skabs 'dir sgrub pa'i dge ba 'di dag gis mtshon nas/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ so so skye bo'i tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho ci mchis pa dang*/ dge la 'dir tshogs pa kun gyi dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyis pa'i mthu dang stobs la brten nas/ khams gsum 'gro ba ma lus phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa= bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i bdud rigs thams cad phyir bzlog par= bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su bgyi ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo yongs su gang bar=

bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa gang na bzhugs pa de thams cad kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar du chod pa mtha' dag zhi= rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las 'gro don thams cad phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par= dge 'dun thams cad thugs mthun cing chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa zab mo gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas= rab tu byung ba rnams lta ba dang grub mtha' mi mthun pas dge 'dun gyi dbyen du 'gyur ba dag spangs te/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas= dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyang rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba'i sems kyi dam pa'i chos ston pa mkhas shing le lo med= ces lan gsum brjod nas/ gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang*// zhes sogs brjod do// yang 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sel ba'i don du ni/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ 'jig rten gyi khams skyong bar byed pa'i lha dang klu la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dgyes pa rnams mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sel ba'i don du/ dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi mchod pa dang thugs dam bskang ba/ bdud rigs phyir zlog par byed pa/ stong nyid zab mo'i bsgrub thabs bgyis pa/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde chen pos mthun pa'i gso sbyongs bgyis pa/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad rang rang gis cho gas mnyes par sgrub pa la sogs pa'i mthu dang stobs la brten nas/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po bde zhing skyid/ bdud rigs kyi bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan= bdud sdig to can gyis sprul pa'i 'khrug pa'i mda' lnga po rang gnas su zhi= dus kyi 'khrug pa dang mtshon gyi bskal pa thams cad zhi= sems can ma rungs pa rnams kyi bsam pa ngan pa thams cad mi 'byung= ma rungs pa rnams kyang phan tshun du pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par= 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du char chu rnams dus su 'bab par=

lo phyugs rtag tu legs par= mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar= yams nad dang rims nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar= ces lan gsum brjod nas/ lhas yang dus su char 'bebs zhing*// sogs dang*/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// sogs brjod do// yang rdo rje slob dpon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po dus min du gshegs pa bzhugs su gsol ba la/ sku tshe 'dor ba'i rgyu dang*/ bzlog pa'i smon lam mo// dang po ni/ dge 'dun gyi sde dbyen du gyur pa dang*/ tshul khrims 'chal ba dang*/ yul khams kyi rgyal po mi dge ba la spyod pas rgyud 'khrug pa dang*/ gdul bya rnams kyi blo'i me long rnyog pa dang*/ chos smra ba la log par sgrub pa'i rkyen dang*/ de'i dbang gis bka' srungs 'khrug pa la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de dag bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad pa sngon du btang nas/ 'di skad ces/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje slob dpon/ chos smra ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ chos kyi rgyal po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba'i slad du/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi sde chen pos mthun pa'i gso sbyong gis dge 'dun mthun par bgyis pa dang*/ bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong gis rgyal po ngan par gyur pa la sogs pa'i yams gsal ba dang*/ tshul khrims dag par byed pa'i gso sbyong gis bslab pa yongs su sbyangs pa dang*/ skal bar 'tshams pa'i skye bo mang po dam pa'i chos smra ba'i stan du sbyar ba dang*/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed cing dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug pa dang*/ dbang blangs zhing dam tshig nyams chags gsos pa dang*/ dkon mchog mchod cing bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang ba dang*/ zab pa dang rgya che'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthu la brten nas mtshan nas smos pa 'di zhes bgyi ba mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so// chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi khams su dge legs rgya chen po 'phel zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs so// zhes lan gsum dang*/

dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu las de kho na nyid du gyur cig ces lan gsum dang*/ ston pa 'jig rten khams su bzhugs pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod do// gnyis pa gshin po'i don du bya ba la gnyis te/ gang zag khyad par can la mchod pa phul nas smon lam gdab pa dang*/ skye bo phal pa la dge ba rjes su 'brang ba'i smon lam gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ bla ma'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam chos skyong ba'i rgyal po sogs yon gyi bdag pos gtso byas bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar yon gyi bdag pos bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod pa/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi tshogs gtor/ skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar can bzhengs su gsol nas/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas nye bar spras te/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par sprul pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs 'di dang*/ gzhan yang yon gyi bdag po sogs gdul byar gtogs pa rnams kyi lus dang longs spyod/ dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa dang*/ rjes su mthun pa 'di ni/ bka' drin mnyam med 'di zhes bgyi ba'i spyan lam du 'bul bar bgyi'o// phul ba de thams cad bdag gi nyid du bzhes te/ thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo gong nas gong du yongs su gang bar gyur cig

gang du bzhugs pa'i zhing khams der mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing rgyas par= 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzhed rgyu thams cad lhun gyis sgrub par= byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che spyad par mdzad pa'i tshe/ sku gsung thugs mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar= thugs rje dang spangs rtogs yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa thams cad dag rim par bstan nas/ yon gyi bdag po sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun mi chad pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa dam pa myur du 'jug par= ces lan gsum brjod nas/ dge ba 'di'i 'gro ba kun// gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du// yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yis// bla ma dam pa mnyes byed shog /ces brjod do// gnyis pa la/ dmigs yul rang gis byas pa'i dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ de'i ched du gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba de'i rjes su 'brang bar smon lam 'debs pa'o// dang po ni/ de nyid kyis byas pa'i dge ba sngar khong rang gis mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyur bsngos zin pa rnams ni slar bsngo dgos pa min te/ gson po'i dus su sngar khong rang gis bsngos zin pa de nyid mchog yin pa'i phyir/ sngar bsngos ma zin pa'am tshe 'di bya ba'i ched du'am/ phyi ma mngon mtho'i ched du bsngos kyang*/ byang chub chen por bsngos ma zin pa rnams ni/ der bsngo dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni 'di ltar/ tshe 'das de'i nye 'brel du gyur pa bla ma'am/ slob ma'am/ pha ma lta bu snying thag pa nas brtse ba can zhig gis bsngos na 'grub pa yin te/ de nyid de'i bya ba la dbang che ba'i phyir/ dper na gson gyi gnas skabs bzhin no// de dag dang rang gis ji lta ba bzhin bsngo ma shes na/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu gzhan zhig la bsngo rten du grags pa'i yon zhig phul nas/ des ji ltar 'dus nas bslabs pa de bzhin du nye 'brel des kyang rtse gcig tu yid kyis 'dun par byas pas 'grub pa yin te/ ngag tu brjod pa'i rim pa ni/ dge 'dun rnams dang nye du 'brel ba can rnams kyis mthun 'gyur mdzad pa zhu zhes brjod la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang zhes pa nas/ dgongs su gsol/ tshe 'das 'di zhes bya bas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ma chags pa dang*/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas kun nas slangs te/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba rang gis bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan bgyid du bcug pa dang*/ ma bcug par yang gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba phul ba la sogs pa'i dkar po dge ba'i las/ khong khro ba'am lam log par rtog pa chen pos bar ma dor chud zos pa nyid du ma gyur pa de dag gi nus pa dang*/ mthu brtan par byed pa'i bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs slar yang mngon par 'du byas pa 'di dag la brten nas/ tshe 'das ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhes dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du rmad du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa rlabs po che zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes sogs dang*/ skyabs rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lta bu mthong ba dang zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang de dag gi mthu las/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig de yang mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun gyi rgyan dang ldan par= de yang 'phags pa'i nor bdun mi 'bral bar= khyad par du dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi'i lus thob= rten der yang mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang sdig grogs kyi dbang du skad cig tsam yang mi 'gro=

dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du ston par mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang zhal mjal bar= zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos spyod pa la spro zhing*/ de ltar spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par= chos dge ba bcu la ngang gis slob par= 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las nges par 'byung bar= bdud bzhi dang dman pa'i sa gnyis las myur du 'da' bar= bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par= spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug la slob par= rnal 'byor byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos la brtson 'grus su bya ba mthar phyin par= mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta bas mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa chod par= sgom pa zung du 'jug pa'i nyams len gyis yon tan gyi tshogs mngon par 'du byed par= 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub las nam yang slar mi bzlog par= ngo bo lhun gyis grub cing mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam= ces lan gsum dang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*// byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed// bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyangs pa yang*// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par shog /ces brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sngags kyi nus pa'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs rje'am/ nye 'brel snying brtse ba'i stobs kyis/ tshe 'das de yang gson dus kyi rnam pa dang mthun par mdun gyi gnas su de nyid bkug nas 'dug par bsam la/ dgongs su gsol zhes pa sngon du btang nas/ 'di zhes bya ba 'jig rten pha rol tu song ba de'i ched du/ nye du 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyis 'di ltar/ tshe 'das khong rang gi bgo skal gyi yo byad la gzhi blangs/ nye du glo ba nye ba rnams kyis kyang mkho rgu lhag par bsnan nas bla ma dang dkon mchog gi mchod pa ngo bo bzang zhing bkod pa khyad par du 'phags par bshams/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi tshogs mchod dang gtor ma dngos po sbungs che zhing*/

cho ga phun sum tshogs shing gtsang spras brgyan par byas/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la bkur sti'i mchod pa dang*/ yo byad bzang po'i bsnyen bkur gyi mnyes par byas/ grong khyer gyi skye bo'i tshogs rnams yul chos dang mthun pa'i zas kha len gyis mchis par byas/ phongs pa dang mgon med pa'i tshogs la snying brtse ba'i sbyin stong rgya chen pos mgu zhing yi rang bar gyur pa dag dang*/ gzhan yang tshe 'das rang gi bar do'i rnam par shes pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i sngags dang phyag rgyas bkug nas zab mo'i chos bshad/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams 'dzin du bcug khong rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal la gnas par byas/ dkyil 'khor chen por bcug cing dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i mnyes byed kyis tshim par byas/ gzugs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' gsung dri ma med pa sgrags shing*/ khro chen 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas dang phyag rgyas tshe 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i gson gyi dus na rnam smin gyi tshe gnas pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus su sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya dang*/ log 'dren gyi tshogs rnams rgyangs ring du bsal/ tshe 'das khong rang gi 'byung ba bzhis skyed pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid ngang du bstim/ lhag pa'i lhas phyin drug gi ngo bor byin gyis brlab pa'i khrus kyi nyon mongs pa'i dri ma drug bkrus nas/ yon tan drug gi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pas dag pa'i zhing du skye bar lung bstan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di thams cad tshe 'das 'di zhes bya ba'i don du phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brangs zhing rjes su 'jug par= rjes su zhugs nas rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung mtha' dag las myur du thar bar=

thar nas kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par= thob nas gzhan don phrin las phun sum tshogs pa 'bad med lhun grub du 'byung bar= ces lan gsum brjod nas/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na// zhes sogs 'don no// gzhan yang de lta bu'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du ngan song gsum gyis mtshon pa'i mi 'khom pa'i gnas rnams su nam yang mi skye bar= bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar= der yang rigs dang gzugs bzang ba rnams kyi mchog tu= dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyi dang*/ mang du thos pa dang shes rab che ba rnams kyi dang*/ brtson 'grus dang tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyi dang*/ gtong ba la dga' ba dang ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa rnams kyi dang*/ 'khor la byams pa dang chog shes pa rnams kyi dang*/ thos pas mi ngoms pa dang chos smra ba la dga' ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu= zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong zhing*// zhes sogs brjod do// gzhan yang de lta bu'i mthu las de zhes bgyi ba bar do'i 'jigs skrag las myur du thar bar= bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa las thar bar= 'jig pa'i sgra bzhi dang nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum las thar bar= gnas skabs der yang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsung thos par= 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong bar= gsang ba'i bdag pos rgyud byin gyis rlobs par= bar do la bar do nyid du ngo shes par= der yang chos ston pa'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa'i gdams ngag rjes su dran par= bar do'i rig pa rang byung gi ye shes mngon du byed par= zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ sangs rgyas sku gsum mnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*// zhes sogs smon lam ci shes pa thams cad skabs dang sbyar nas gdab bo// yang tshe 'das kyi don du lho sgo'i cho ga dang 'brel na/ bar do'i chos bshad logs su mi dgos mod/

bsngo ba smon lam tsam dang 'brel ba'i tshe skabs der rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid phyag na rdo rje'i skur bskyed/ skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur mi bskyod pa'i rgyas gdab/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas 'di skad ces brjod do// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i byin gyis brlab kyis/ tshe 'das 'di zhes bgyi ba/ 'gro ba rigs drug dang 'brel ba'i srid pa bar ma do gang du gnas kyang*/ sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mched grogs dang*/ pha ma nye 'brel snying nye zhing sems 'dun pa dag gang na 'khod pa'i gnas 'dir sngon gyi bag chag 'thug po dag dang mthun par myur ba nyid du 'khor bar gyis shig ces lan gsum brjod nas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod skye ba snga ma'i rnam smin gyi lus bor nas/ deng sang zhag bdun phrag bdun du gnas pa'i skabs yin/ bar do'i lus 'di dang*/ shing thogs pa med pa rlung sems tsam las grub pa yin pas/ yid dam lha'i sku dang 'gro ba bzang ngan gyi lus gang du yang sgyur du btub/ sems kyi 'phen pa bzang ngan dang drag zhan gyi yi dam gyi lha dang bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro gang du yang mtshams sbyar du rung*/ khyod sngon bla ma dam pas bstan pa'i bar do'i gdams pa yod na de nyid dran pa byed dgos/ phyi de yang med na phyi nang gi snod bcud du snang ba 'di thams cad swa bha wa'i sngags don bsam nas stong par thag chod la/ snod kyi 'jig rten du snang ba 'di thams cad gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can du snang ba de thams cad rigs gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sgra grag pa thams cad ma ṇi dang*/ badz+ra pa ṇi sogs kyi sngags su shes par byos la/ spyir gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad spong*/ gang du skye ba'i gnas mthong nas/ de la mngon par zhen pa dang*/ dga' ba'i rtog pa yid la ma byed/

khyad par gnas gang na skyes pa dang bud med nyal po byed par shom pa mthong na/ de dag la chags pa dang sdang ba'i blo ma skyed/ de tsam gyis kyang mngal sgo mi khegs par mthong na snying rje dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor/ mi'i skyes gnas gang yin pa de rdo rje bdag med ma'i chos 'byung gi gnas su shes par byas la/ khyad par rang gi kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs sam/ dhī dang hūm̐ las 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po gang mos su bskyed la nying mtshams sbyor shig de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen por 'khrungs te/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de bas kyang bar do nyid du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byed nus na mchog tu 'gyur bas 'di ltar dgongs shig pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khyod rang gi shes pa hūm̐ las phyag na rdo rje/ sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'phros pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang*/ phyag g.yas pa ye shes kyi rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar bas bdud dang gshin rje'i pho nya phyir bsnyil ba/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub thugs khar mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dmar la bzlum pa/ de'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam du bcug nas slob dpon gyis/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu/ zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa la/ gshin po de la bsngos pa'i mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ so so'i sngags rgyas phul/ bstod pa dang bkra shis brjod/ de ltar gshin po'i don du bsngo ba rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang*/ mjug tu rjes ma rnams la shis pa'i smon lam gal che bas 'di ltar/ gzhan yang bsod nams 'di dag gi mthu las/ bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par= bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe ring bar= bshad bsgrub la bar chad mi 'byung bar= yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po bde bar=

de'i mthu la brten nas/ yon gyi bdag po shul na mchis pa rnams kyis 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar= tshe dang bsod nams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par= ji ltar bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa nyid du 'grub par= mthar thug ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god nus par= gnas skabs su 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol nus= de ltar byed nus pa de'i ched du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed nus= de ma thob kyi bar du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod nas/ gang gis sbyin pa zhes sogs dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du zhes sogs dang*/ klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo// gzhan yang grong khyer gnas pa rnams// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde ba thob par shog /ces sogs bkra shis rgyas par brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub mchod dang tshogs 'khor gyi gral lta bur yin na/ gong du smos zin pa'i mol gtam bsdus pa de ltar btang nas/ bsngo ba ni rigs thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa khyab byed rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dang*/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yum bzhi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs/ mdor na gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs thams cad rig pa 'dzin pa bdag dang rdo rje spun grogs slob mar bcas pa rnams dang*/ mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yon gyi bdag po rnams la dgongs su gsol/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di dag gis tshogs dang yo byad sbyar/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag dang slob ma las kyi rdo rje'i tshogs dang bcas pas rang nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid zhugs shing dbang blangs pa dang*/ slob ma'i tshogs la dbang bskur ba dang*/ gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs shing*/

mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyi dri ma bsangs/ stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi tshim par byin gyis brlabs nas phul/ ye shes kyi lha'i tshogs tshim par byas pa dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad la tha mal du zhen pa'i rtog pa sbyangs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs/ nam mkha' dang mnyam par sbar te ci bde bar longs spyod nas/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim zhing*/ lhag ma'i gtor mas 'byung po'i khyad par mang po dag ngoms shing dga' bar byas pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rlabs po che 'di la brten nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dgyes shing tshim nas/ rang nyid rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ de ltar byin gyis brlab nas rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'char bar gyur cig bdud bzhi dang sa gnyis la bar du gcod pa mtha' dag las skyob par gyur cig chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis tshe dang bsod nams kyi bar chad sel zhing*/ mchod pa dang tshogs kyi yo byad la nye bar mkho ba rnams char bzhin du 'bebs par= zhes lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshogs gnyis kyi bgyi ba 'di dag gi mthu las/ dam tshig gi slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rigs thams cad kyi mgon po dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgyur ba nyid du nges par mthong nas/ de'i bka' las skad cig kyang 'da' bar ma gyur cig sgo thams cad nas mnyes pa kho na sgrub par byed cing*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i chos kyi mdzod la longs spyod par= stong pa nyid kyi sngags don bsam pas ma dag pa'i snang ba nub= bsrung ba'i 'khor los bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'joms par= bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor pas gang shar lhag pa'i lha nyid du rtogs par=

rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor pas skyed rim gyi lha ye shes su rtogs par= bum dbang gi rtogs pa goms pas phung po lnga gnas gyur gyi ye shes rgyud la skye= 'khor 'das gnyis 'jig rten gyi rtog pa rang sar dag nas zung 'jug brjod bral gyi ye shes rgyud la skye= gsang dbang gi rtogs pa goms pas bde stong gi ye shes ngang gis 'char bar= rang byung gi ye shes la mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa rang sar dag par= dbang gsum pa'i thabs nyams su blangs pas shes rab kyi stobs las byung ba'i ye shes mngon du byed= brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi nyi ma rnam par rtog pa'i sprin tshogs las grol bar= dbang bzhi pa'i nyams len la goms pas mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mngon du byed nus= g.yo med phyag rgya chen po'i rnam rol las nam yang mi 'da' bar= phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byed nus= rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i go 'phang brnyes nas slob ma'i tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu smin cing grol bar byed nus par= ces lan gsum dang*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i tshig yin pas// bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor pa rnams kun// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dang*/ bkra shis rgyas pa brjod do// mol gtam rin chen phreng ba dang*// yon bshad ut+pal do shal gyis// gang gi mgul pa rnam brgyan pa// mang po'i gral mgor 'khod la dbang*// mang po tshogs pa'i khyams chen du// kun gyis bkur ba'i seng ge'i khri// mthon po'i steng nas gzhan gyi yid// 'phrog byed spobs pa thob 'dod na// gtam dang blo ba 'di bzung la// tshig lhad spangs pa'i brjod pa yis// skad bzangs mtho la snyan gyur pas// dal brel snyoms pa'i bkra shis spyon// gang 'di la stod thang chung ba// grub chen shākya seng ge yi// rigs brgyud 'dzin pa'i dbon dag gis// bskul nas gser mdog can gyi grwar// mi pham dges pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// sbyar bas 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yid rab dang nas bsod nams dang*// ye shes chud mi za bar shog/

//bkra shis// ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ ngo mtshar dad pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor/ sgo gsum gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod de/ gsol ba btab na dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi dgos 'dod mtha' yas pa bde blag tu mdzad pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ don gnyis mthar phyin stong pa sangs rgyas/ sgrib gnyis mun sel skyob pa dam chos/ rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa na bzhugs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ khyad par du yang*/ dpal 'byor chu bo 'dus pa'i zhing sa/ legs bshad chu gtsang 'bab pa'i 'jug ngogs/ mkhas grub skye bo 'du ba'i bsti gnas/ rang re'i gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid na/ byin rlabs chu rgyun spel ba'i gangs ri/ nyes pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i dag byed/ rnam dag dge legs spel ba'i sa gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar can rnams kyi drung na/ 'byor pa'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i chu gter/ bkod legs mtshar du dngar ba'i phreng mdzes/ yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis spras te/ bstan pa'i gangs ri bsrung ba'i seng chen/ bstan 'dzin ri dwags skyongs ba'i rgyal po/ bdud dpung glang po 'joms pa'i stobs ldan/ dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa bzhugs shing*/ bstan pa dam chos kun gyi bdag po/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun kun gyi gtsug rgyan/ ston pa thub pa chen po'i rgyal tshab/ drung mkhan chen pa'i zhal mnga' nas 'dus pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par bzhugs pa legs shing*/ de dag gi rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las kyi rnga sgra phyogs brgyar g.yo ba la brten nas nye bar bsdus pa/ legs bshad 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i sprin chen/ smra ngan brag ri bsnyil ba'i gnam lcags/

gsung rab dgongs don gsal ba'i me long*/ slob dpon yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyis gral gyi thog ma mdzad/ bsod nams mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i lhun po/ skye 'gro yongs kyi bkur ba'i mchod 'os/ mtho dman yongs la snyoms pa'i nam mkha'/ mi che bar gyur pa rnams kyis gral gyi gong mnan/ rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i mkhas pa/ ngur smrig rgyal mtshan g.yo ba'i btsun po/ lhag bsam nor gyis phyug pa'i bzang po/ dge 'dun dbus sde gnyis kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung*/ sde snod chu klung 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ rgyud sde nor bus gtams pa'i mtsho chen/ blo gsal bung ba bsdud pa'i dga' tshal/ yon tan mkhas par mkhyen pa rnams kyis gral gyi zur brgyan/ gang la ci 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu/ longs spyod 'bras bu smin pa'i dpag bsam/ gtong phod sgo mang phye ba'i khang bzang*/ yon gyi bdag po chen po rnams dang*/ rnam dpyod bzhin mdangs gsal ba'i zla ba/ yid 'ongs gtsang spras brgyan pa'i bram ze/ bde 'khyug phyogs brgyar gsal ba'i glog phreng*/ lag bde ba rnams pas gral gyi mtha' brten te/ 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad gdan 'dzom zhing 'brel pa zab/ thugs mngon par dgyes pa dang ldan zhing tshogs pa bzang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po thugs brtse ba ldan zhing mi mthun pa med par bzhugs pa legs/ lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus dang*/ rgyan dam pa chos 'byung gi lo rgyus gnyis/ dang po la/ steng du rje'i gdung rabs/ 'og tu 'bangs gi mi rabs/ stong sde sa'i chags tshul/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag la sogs pa mang zhig gleng bar gda' na'ang*/ zhib zlas snyan du mi gsol/ mdo tsam gyi dbang du bgyis na/ rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba la sogs pa bskal pa dang po'i rgyal po lnga/ brgya byin gyi stan phyed la dbang sgyur ba nga la nu sogs 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po lnga/

ma ga ta'i rgyal po gzugs can snying po/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gtum po rab snang*/ bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed/ ser skya'i rgyal po gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa'i bar tu spel legs su byon pa lags shing*/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i gdung rje gnya' khri btsan po de nyid chos kyi rgyal po la snga ba lags shing*/ de nas gnam gyi khri bdun/ sa'i legs drug bar gyi lde brgyad la sogs pa rim par brgyud cing*/ khyad par nyi shu rtsa lnga la lha tho tho ri'i snyan shal gyi dus su dam pa'i chos kyi dbu rnyed/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su srol gtod/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyis rab tu byung ba rnams kyi zhabs spyi bor blangs/ rab tu byung ba re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal skad gsar bcad kyi gtan la phab/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sku ring la gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i bstan pa bod du gdan drangs/ jo bo rje lha gcig bod du spyan 'dren pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa sogs chos rgyal gyi skyes bu chen po rnams gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bar ma chad par byon pa lags/ gnyis pa 'bangs kyi mi rabs kyi dbang du byas na/ dang por 'dzam gling pa rnams lha yul nas 'phos pa yin zhing*/ rigs so so'i dbye ba med cing*/ phyis rtsod ldan gyi dus su mi rigs bzhir dbye bas ding sang 'phags yul na rigs bzhi'i sde tshan so sor nges/ rgya nag na rigs 'chol bar gnas/ bod chung ngu ni rigs kyi dbye ba med/ bod chen po na mi'u gdong drug gi rigs so sor nges pa las/ de ring yon gyi bdag po rnams rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa/ 'di zhes bya ba dang*/ mdzad pa 'phrin las 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba dang ldan pa lags/ gsum pa stong sde sa'i 'chags tshul la/ phyi mngon pa'i lugs dang*/

nang gsang sngags kyi lugs sogs mang po zhig gleng bar gda' na'ang*/ mdor bsdus na gling khyad par du 'phags pa 'dzam bu gling na/ yul chen sum cu so drug yul phran brgya dang drug cu yod kyang*/ shar na longs spyod kyi 'byung gnas rgya nag lho na chos kyi 'byung gnas 'phags yul/ nub na rig pa'i 'byung gnas kha che/ byang na dpa' bo'i 'byung gnas hor yul/ dbus na srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad kyi 'byung gnas kha ba can gyi ljongs te/ ya rabs gnas pa'i yul chen de tsam du 'dus pa lags/ bzhi pa 'jig rten lugs kyi rnam gzhag la/ rdzogs ldan gyi dus su rgyal po'i khrims dang*/ 'jig rten gyi lugs bzang ngan gyi dbye ba med cing*/ sum ldan gyi mgo zug nas/ dge ba bcu yi khrims dang*/ 'jig rten gyi lugs bzang ngan dang*/ rigs mtho dman dang*/ ya rabs dang ma rabs kyi spyod tshul sna tshogs dang*/ dpa' ba dang mdzangs pa la sogs gzugs bzang ngan la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi gzhung lugs rnams rim gyis dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa lags/ mdor na mi chos kyi lo rgyus de dag thams cad kyang*/ yab du dges zhing yum du btsun/ ngo tsha shes pa'i lus la khrel yod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la tshang ba lags/ gnyis pa dam pa chos 'byung ba'i lo rgyus la/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshul/ byas shes bka' drin che tshul dang gsum las/ dang po la/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ bskal pa bzang po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba sogs mang zhig gleng bar gda' na'ang*/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di brjod du med pa'i bskal pa mang po'i snga rol tu sangs rgyas nas/ rtsod pa'i dus 'dir gling bzhi ther 'bum du mchog gi sprul pa'i skus ngo mtshar can gyi mdzad pa bye ba brgya phrag cig car du bstan pa de lags/

bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi dar tshul la/ thub dbang chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba rim par mdzad/ bsdu ba gsum pa'i dus su gsung rab rnams yi ger bris/ rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i dgongs 'grel mkhan po rnams kyis bstan bcos mang du mdzad nas/ 'phags yul du phyis bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur pa lags/ bod du sprul pa'i sku thon mi sam bho ṭas bod kyi yi ge brtsams/ dam pa chos kyi srol gtod/ chos kyi spyan ldan ka cog zhang gsum gyis sde snod gsum dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus par bsgyur/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa lo chen nam mkha' bzang pos/ rgyud sde bzhi tshad ldan gyi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa bod du bsgyur/ rgyal ba'i sras po blo ldan shes rab kyis/ gsung rab mang po'i zhu chen mdzad cing*/ gangs can gyi ljongs su bshad rgyud kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ 'ban rog dar gsum/ bya khyi sha gsum la sogs pa rnams kyis ka cog zhang gsum nas brgyud pa'i 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi bstan pa dar zhing ma nub par mdzad/ jo bo rje bod du byon nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i sde snod kyi sgo nas theg pa chen po'i bka' gdam gyi srol btsugs/ kha che paṇa chen bod du byon nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la slob pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ dam pa rgya gar bod du byon na lta ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ rten 'brel sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gro ba mang po la phan 'dogs pa'i chos kyi srol btsugs/ sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du byon nas gdug pa can tshar bcad de gsang sngags bla na med pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ rje btsun mar pa lo tsās rgya gar du byon nas nā ro dang mai tri'i gdams pa blangs nas bod du sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar btsugs par mdzad/

grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i zab chos blangs nas/ gangs can gyi dbul ba sel bar mdzad/ bla ma sa skya pa khu dbon gyis mdo sngags kyi bstan pa ma lus pa dar rgyas mdzad cing*/ 'jig rten lugs kyi sgo nas 'gro ba mang po smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ gsum pa bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus la/ spyir sangs rgyas sems can la bka' drin che/ khyad par du mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid/ mi mjed 'jig rten khams pa rnams la bka' drin che/ de las khyad par du 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis gnyis la sogs pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po rnams dang*/ tai lo dang nā ro/ in+d+ra bhu ti dang*/ dus zhabs la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ bod kha ba can gyi ljongs pa rnams la dang por sprul pa'i chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ bar du bla chen mkhan brgyud/ mthar yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇa chen a ti sha chos brgyud dang bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par rang re'i chos brgyud rnam par dag pa 'di nyid la rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa'i dbang po nas bzung ste/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa rnams bka' drin che/ sgos rang rang so so la lus sems skyon med bskrun par byed pa'i pha ma/ rnam dag khrims la 'god par byed pa'i mkhan po dang slob dpon/ dbang bzhis smin par byed pa'i dam tshig gi bla ma/ blang dor skyon med ston par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ gzhung lugs tshul bzhin ston par byed pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa/ thar pa'i lam du bgrod pa'i mched grogs rdo rje spun dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ khyad par du de ring gi gnas skabs su/ gzhan sde'i dregs pa 'dzoms pa'i dpa' bo/ rang sde byams pas skyong ba'i mdzangs pa/

mkhas btsun rgyan gyis spras pa'i bla ma/ drung pa nyid zhabs mngon par mtho ba'i skyabs kyi 'og nas longs spyod ngang gis 'du ba'i mtsho chen/ legs bshad bung ba 'du ba'i skyed tshal/ 'byor ldan bsod nams bsog pa'i zhing sa/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams la/ mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil/ 'bul ba ri ltar spungs/ phyag bde ba glog ltar 'khrug dad gus dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas/ chos spyod yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ bar bzhugs pa'i dgos pa skabs don/ zhes sogs dang sbyar bar bya'o// bsdus par byed na/ dkon mchog chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i skyabs kyi 'og nas/ rang re'i dpon slob rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du gdan mngon par 'chags/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge 'dun sde gnyis kyi gral gyi gzhi bzung*/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen pos gral gyi gung mnan/ gang shar lha sku'i rnam rol du gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi gral gyi thog ma mdzad/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las ma g.yos bzhin du rgyud sde'i don phyin ci ma log par 'chad shes pa'i yon tan mkhyen pa rnams gral gyi zur brgyan/ gsang sngags kyi kun spyod las ma g.yos bzhin du phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub par mdzad pa'i las kyi rdo rje rnam pas gral gyi mtha' brten te/ 'di ltar zhal mngon sum du gyur pa'i rdo rje spun thams cad kyang*/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pas ma gos zhing 'brel pa zab/ tshogs pa bzangs/ lo rgyus/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/ rigs brgya'i rnal 'byor gyis dngos po kun la khyab byed du bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ 'di ltar tshangs par spyod pa'i rtags la nye bar gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs la/

tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rjes su mthun pa'i dpa' bo'i ston mo bzang zhing gya nom la nye bar mchod pa 'di nyid/ spyir gyi na rig pa 'dzin pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir dang*/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du gsang sngags kyi kun spyod bzang po dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir/ yon gyi bdag po rdo rje slob dpon ming 'di zhes bya bas bsgrub par gda' bas de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rigs thams cad kyi bdag po khyab bdag rdo rje sems pa'i go 'phang du/ bsngo bar bgyid pa'i mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ sbyin bdag bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir du bsngo ba byed na/ thog mar 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ sbyin pa'i bdag po khyod rang thugs 'di ltar 'jog par mdzod/ ji skad du mdo las/ tshogs bsags pa la bde ba 'byung*// de phyir mi yi bsod nams bsags// de ni yang dang yang du bsags// de nyid la yang 'dun pa bya// zhes gsungs pas/ 'byor pa byed pa'i dus su bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa gal che zhing*/ bsags pa de nyid yul khyad par can du 'dun pas bsgyur ba gal che zhing*/ de yang gang du bsngo na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// ched du bya ba ni sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo'o// dgos pa ni mi zad par bya ba'i ched du'o// gang du bsngo na/ rang gzhan gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa bsngo bas bsgyur ba rnams so// rnam pa ni sbyin pa po dang*/ len pa po dang*/ sbyin par bya ba'i rdzas de/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin cing*/ snang cha ma dor ba'i thabs kyis bsngo'o// de ltar bsngo ba la brten nas/ bral ba'i 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob/ rnam smin dang bdag po'i 'bras bu bde 'gro mtho ris su skye/

rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu tshe 'di dang phyi ma longs spyod chen po 'byung*/ de lta bu'i 'bras bu 'byin pa yang dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ chos dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po las byung ba yin snyam pa mdzod la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur mdzad pa zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la dgongs su gsol/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs 'dis mtshon byed du byas/ dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyin pa'i bdag po rang gi bsgrub pa dang*/ gzhan bgyid du bcug pa dang*/ gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang phul ba'i dge ba ci mchis pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig sgrib pa gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bde blag tu byang bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ gzhan yang sbyin pa'i bdag po skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi rgyan dang ldan par gyur cig skyabs rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lta bu mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig lam rnam par dag pa dam pa'i chos rgya mtsho lta bu nyams su len pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig grogs rnam par dag pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig lta ba rnam par dag pa dbu ma'i lta ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig spyod pa rnam par dag pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bsgom pa rnam par dag pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi nyams len dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

'bras bu rnam par dag pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang du myur du thob par gyur cig phrin las rnam par dag pa lhun grub rgyun mi chad kyi sems can thams cad kyi re 'dod tshul bzhin du bskong nus par gyur cig tshe 'di nyid la'ang*/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig ji ltar bsam pa thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de la gegs kyi rnam pa skad cig tsam yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig ces kyang brjod/ spyir thun mong gi bsngo ba tsam byed na// dgongs su gsol/ bdag gzhan rnams kyis 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i dge rtsa rnams phyogs gcig tu sdom pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa phyogs ga na bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las dang 'gro don phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig dge 'dun thams cad kyang thugs mthun cing yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa la sogs pa chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig de dag gi byin rlabs la brten nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can la bde skyed kyi dpal phun sum tshogs par gyur cig yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad bde bar gyur cig dus kyi 'khrug pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig yams kyi nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig sad dang ser ba dang mu ge thams cad zhi bar gyur cig sems can ma rungs pa rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig

sems can thams cad phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig lta ba tha dad pa mi mthun pa zing zing pa dag spangs te yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas par gyur cig byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs chen yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig 'phags pa dges pa'i tshul khrims kyi dga' ba dang ldan par gyur cig nyon mongs pa'i gdung bas mi rdzi ba'i rnam par grol ba'i bde ba la gnas par gyur cig gzhan yang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig po// sogs brjod/ nad pa'i don du bsngo ba rgyas par byed na/ dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ che ge mo'i rlung dang*/ mkhris pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig ldan pa dang 'dus pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig blo bur gyi rkyen drang po las byung ba'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig gdon bgegs dang 'byung po'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig bgegs dang log 'dren gyi gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig btsan dang the rang gi gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig dus ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig bdud kyi zhags pa dang gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig ltas ngan pa thams cad rab zhi bar gyur cig tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod de/ bsdus pa byed na/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i/ sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// de kun nad las thar bar shog /'gro ba'i nad ni ma lus pa// rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ tshe las 'das ma thag gi don du bsngo ba byed na/ thams cad tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bgyi ba la dgongs su gsol/

'di zhes bgyi ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du/ 'dod chags med pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kho rang gis bgyi ba dang*/ de'am ched du dmigs te/ bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma btang ba/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur ba/ gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' srung dri ma med pa bsgrags pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po rnams su bcug cing dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa thams cad/ tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug srid pa bar ma do gang du skyes sam skye ba'i rigs can gcig yin na'ang*/ de'i phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing phyi bzhin du 'jug par gyur cig zhugs nas kyang rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ci yod las thar bar gyur cig tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag mtha' dag las myur du thar bar gyur cig 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum la sogs pa bar do'i 'jig skrag mtha' dag las myur du thar bar gyur cig ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba rnams su nam yang mi skye bar gyur cig bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi'i lus rten phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig rigs bzang ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu skye bar gyur cig mang du thos pa dang tshul khrims srungs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu skye bar gyur cig gtong ba la dga' ba dang ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu skye bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ gzhan yang tshe las 'das pa'i rgyud la sangs rgyas pa'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

sogs dang*/ tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ces sogs skabs dang sbyar/ tshe las 'das nas yun ring por song ba'i don du bsngo ba bsdus pa brjod na/ dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa la brten/ tshe las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong zhing zhes sogs dang*/ srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na// zhes sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// zhes sogs dang*/ khong gi rgyud la/ byang chub sems ni rin po che// zhes sogs smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab bo// bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa yul khyad par can gyi don du mchod par 'bul na/ phyogs bcu nas dge 'dun btsun pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshogs dang bcas pa la dgongs su gsol/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i dge tshogs rnams dang*/ lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po phyi nang gsang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ci mchis dang*/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams na/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa 'di dag thams cad chos kyi rje'am/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ sa skyong rgyal po la sogs pa'i drung du dbul bar bgyi'o// de ltar phul ba la brten nas/ gang na bzhugs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzung po'i mchod sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzhed dgu thams cad lhun gyi grub par gyur cig byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig de'i tshe sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig

thugs rje dang spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa byang bar gyur cig chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang brnyes par gyur cig sprul pa'i sku 'bum phrag grangs med du mas mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa dam pa bde blag tu myur du 'jug par gyur cig de dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bdag cag rnams skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du skad cig tsam yang mi 'gro bar gyur cig zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang zhal mjal bar gyur cig de dag las gdam pa dang*/ rjes su bstan pa'i chos ma lus pa nod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig gnas skabs thams cad du sgo thams cad nas mnyes pa kho na 'byung bar gyur cig mi mnyes pa skad cig tsam yang mi bsgrub par gyur cig skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du lam bsgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du dam pa'i chos spyod pa la spro zhing dam pa'i chos spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod do// 'dir gang bsngo na/ rang gis byas pa'i dge ba rnams so// gang du bsngo na gnas skabs mngon mtho dang*/ mthar thug nges legs su'o// de la'ang byang chub gsum gyi dbye bas gsum yod kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni mchog yin no// ched du bya ba ni sems can thams cad kyi don du'o// dgos pa ni mi zad par bya ba'i ched du'o// tshul ji ltar bsngo na/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/

snang cha ma dor ba'i thabs gnyis kyi sgo nas so// bsngo ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ rang gis byas pa'i dge ba rnams yul khyad par can du 'gyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// bsngo ba po ni/ dge rtsa sog par byed pa rang nyid do// rang gis mi shes na mkhan po la sogs pa gzhan byed du bcug nas/ de'i tshig rjes su rang gi yid 'dun par byed pa'o// tshul khrims ldan pa mang pos mthun 'gyur byas na 'grub sla ba yin te/ tshul khrims ldan pas smon pa 'grub ces gsungs pa bzhin no// gnas ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs par mos pa'i mngon sum du'o// yongs 'du'i shing la gnas bcas pa'i// bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zad mi shes// bag yod legs byas chung ngu yang*// bsngo bas mi zad 'phel bar byed// ces bya ba 'di ni/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ g.yas ru gtsang gi sa'i thig ler sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
